title: fix(cron): cancel interrupted status and history reads
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes: interrupting `cron status`, `get`, `runs`, or a read-only `scratch` query leaves the Gateway request running until the CLI launcher forcibly kills it about two seconds later.

## User Impact

These queries now stop promptly on Ctrl-C/SIGTERM and exit 130/143 without printing a late result or error. Interrupted write operations still report their receipts.

## Why This Change Was Made

Finish the remaining Cron read commands using the existing command cancellation and Gateway transport owners. This follows the accepted list/show behavior from #187726 and preserves run-wait, mutation and scratch compare-and-swap custody. No configuration, protocol/schema, permission-policy or upgrade changes.

## Evidence

Product head: `1ea4cc3557bb7022a2d6c6546264f1227e8dc862`.
BASE: `c324818cbf86074f34578d07f381b0d2835955a1`.
Proof command: `python3 cron-read-cancel-proof-v1.py CHECKOUT FRESH_OUTPUT NODE26 EXPECTATION` (the same collector and scenarios on both heads).

- [Actual before/after CLI evidence, commands and scope](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/1e216186457d6f9c95838dd6f71dd14e29146c99/EVIDENCE.md): the same frozen collector runs the normal built `openclaw.mjs` through a real PTY and compatible local WebSocket peer. Fourteen read interruptions change from launcher SIGKILL at about 2.05 seconds to natural 130/143 within 131 ms; correlated peer closure takes at most 44 ms.
- [BASE streams](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/1e216186457d6f9c95838dd6f71dd14e29146c99/base-streams.txt) / [HEAD streams](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/1e216186457d6f9c95838dd6f71dd14e29146c99/head-streams.txt): all thirteen ordinary/error/write-receipt controls retain byte-identical output. Zero late read documents, surviving owned CLI groups, unclosed peer connections or collector watchdog kills; all 27 isolated configurations retain their bytes.
- [199 focused tests and scoped checks](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/1e216186457d6f9c95838dd6f71dd14e29146c99/checks.json) pass; [independent adversarial review](https://github.com/Alix-007/openclaw/blob/1e216186457d6f9c95838dd6f71dd14e29146c99/independent-review.md) passes with no findings. This was the authorized review fallback, not an official autoreview-tool run.

Production: +59/-27 lines across three registration files. Tests: +26/-7 lines in the existing command table, with a separate 19-LF allocation. No new RPC or cancellation policy; the preflight checked existing cancellation support and all Cron read/write siblings.

The peer uses synthetic data to verify actual CLI transport, output and lifecycle behavior. Not tested: real Gateway storage/scheduler effects, external providers, production channels, Windows/macOS or full repository CI. Peers were stopped after observation; only isolated evidence fixtures remain.
